ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier Articles L.561-1 through L.561-56 and R.561-1 through R.561-41; Code de commerce Articles L.123-2, R.123-223, R.123-224 and A.123-113; Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5) as transposed; national decree no. 2020-115 on the registre des bénéficiaires effectifs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or equivalent corporate existence certificate of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the shareholder's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national identity card of each proposed gérant (manager)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent police, consular, or notarial authority of the individual's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney or corporate board resolution authorizing the French incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent corporate authority of the principal's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing for each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or tax authority of the shareholder's country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed managers, shareholders, and beneficial owners against the French national sanctions list, the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council sanctions lists, and applicable PEP databases. Compliance is governed by Code monétaire et financier Articles L.561-4 through L.561-6 and FIC (Tracfin) guidance; enhanced due diligence is required if any person is identified as a PEP or a close associate/family member of a PEP.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique Electronique and INPI data.inpi.fr (Réservation de dénomination sociale via Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; searchable through Registre National des Entreprises)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be stated in French language script; foreign-language names are permitted only if transliterated or accompanied by a French description. The name must be available in the French national company register and must not infringe prior trademarks or protected commercial names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may first submit an informal objection in writing to the Greffier du Tribunal de Commerce. Following formal refusal, the applicant may file an application with the Président du Tribunal de Commerce seeking an order mandating registration. Further appeal lies to the Cour d'appel within one month of notification. The appeal and any required filings must be made in French.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office (domiciliation) is permitted for administrative registration of an SARL, subject to a signed domiciliation contract and, if applicable, registration of the domiciliation provider. However, for a manufacturer of rugged industrial computers and edge gateways, virtual-office-only arrangements are insufficient to establish genuine commercial substance; the company must maintain or contractually secure physical premises, warehousing, or production facilities in France, and must be able to demonstrate real economic activity for customs, VAT, and corporate income tax purposes.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; estimated at below 5% in any given financial year for a low-risk industrial exporter with no statutory license, absent specific customs or VAT anomalies, abnormal domiciliation patterns, or errant declarations. Probability increases proportionally if the company engages in significant intra-EU movement of goods or claims zero-rated exports without documentary evidence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — portal: impots.gouv.fr; customs and export controls: Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) — douane.gouv.fr; business registry filing via Guichet Unique — formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a French SARL: (1) file incorporation with the Guichet Unique online portal; (2) obtain SIREN (9-digit) and SIRET numbers, automatically assigned by INSEE upon registration; (3) obtain the French intra-Community VAT number ('FR' + 2-digit key + SIREN) from the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) — mandatory before the first taxable transaction; for non-established foreign entities, registration is made with the DGFiP non-resident unit with Form 14743-SD and, if non-EU, appointment of a tax representative approved by the DGFiP tax representative service (Service de l'administration fiscale — état des représentants fiscaux); (4) open a French or EU bank account and publish the Kbis extract from the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; all filings use electronic signatures and certified accountants are mandatory for financial statements.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — SARL defaults to Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) at 25% standard rate on domestic and foreign-source profit subject to territoriality (Art. 209 CGI); foreign PE profits can be exempt if the company provides proof of foreign tax paid and the PE is not in a tax haven; scope of industrial manufacturing is fully taxable under IS with full input VAT deduction.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: 1) Pass-through election (option IR): SARLs meeting 2-of-3 size tests (≤50 employees, ≤EUR 10M assets, ≤EUR 10M turnover) and managed from France may elect income tax treatment under Art. 239 bis AA CGI for a maximum of five fiscal years; 2) VAT group election (assujetti unique) under Art. 256 C CGI for integrated entities; 3) consolidated corporate tax group (intégration fiscale) under Art. 223 A CGI if parent holds ≥95%; 4) no US-style check-the-box regime exists; hybrid mismatch rules under ATAD (Art. 212 bis CGI) and DAC6/MDR cross-border arrangement disclosure apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: TVA — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (Value Added Tax; EU VAT Directive implemented via Code Général des Impôts Art. 256 et seq.)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Domestic franchise en base de TVA: EUR 85,000 main turnover threshold for sales of goods in France (2025; reduced ceiling EUR 93,500; EUR 37,500 threshold for services at reduced ceiling EUR 41,750); non-established foreign suppliers: zero threshold, registration from the first taxable transaction; intra-EU distance sales: EUR 10,000 EU-wide annual ceiling; B2B industrial export dispatches: compulsory registration from the first transaction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing (facturation électronique) through DGFiP-certified Partner Dematerialization Platforms (PDPs) or the Public Billing Portal (PPF). Receiving obligation for all VAT-registered entities from 1 September 2026; issuance obligation from 1 September 2026 for large enterprises and from 1 September 2027 for mid-caps and SMEs. Mandatory structured formats: Factur-X (hybrid), UBL 2.1, or UN/CEFACT CII — transmitted via the four-corner PEPPOL-style network; e-reporting data (supply chain and platform transaction records) must be transmitted before the 10th day of the month following the transaction; no real-time fiscal digital stamping is applied (unlike Italian SDI clearance); non-compliant invoices are null for input VAT recovery and subject to EUR 15 per invoice penalty (capped at EUR 15,000).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to: (1) definitive exports of goods outside the EU under Art. 262-I-1° CGI, provided physical departure from EU territory is evidenced; (2) intra-EU dispatches to a buyer holding a valid intra-EC VAT number under Art. 262 ter-1° CGI, provided a VIES-validated VAT certificate and transport documentation to another member state are held; (3) auxiliary services (transport, handling, insurance) directly linked to the exported goods under Art. 262-I-2° CGI. The exempt character is maintained if all proof is in hand before the 5th day of the month following the dispatch; goods must physically leave the EU within 90 days of delivery. Input VAT on manufacturing costs remains fully deductible.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'Exportation — submitted via DELTA-X electronic customs system, attested by customs clearance number)
Transport Evidence: Bill of Lading (B/L for ocean freight), CMR consignment note (road), or Air Waybill (AWB for air freight) evidencing exit from EU territory
Commercial Invoice (facture commerciale) stating Incoterms, export price, destinations, and harmonized HS codes (ISIC 2620 / HTS 8471 / HS 8471.50)
Inward Remittance Certificate — bank transfer proof (SWIFT MT103) or receiving bank certificate confirming final settlement of export proceeds

Intra-EU dispatch proof: buyer's VIES certificate (extract from the European VAT database) and, for industrial computers exceeding civilian thresholds, dual-use export license issued by DGDDI/SBD when applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGFiP maintains dedicated export verification units performing documentary coincidence audits (invoice vs. customs declaration vs. transport document vs. bank remittance). Failure to substantiate export within the prescribed deadlines triggers re-invoicing of the 20% VAT and late-payment interest at 0.2% per month (Art. 1727 CGI). Penalty escalation: 40% for deliberate misstatement (manquement délibéré, Art. 1729 CGI); 80% for wilful fraud, abuse of law, or fictitious export operations (Art. 1729-b CGI); criminal sanctions under Art. 1741 CGI and Art. 414-2 Code des douanes reach up to EUR 750,000 fine and 7 years imprisonment; customs declaration falsification triggers penalties of up to three times the evaded duties plus confiscation of transported goods; retrospective clawback covers the entire VAT period, interest, and penalties without statute-of-limitation relief for organized fraud (extended to 10 years for hidden activities).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a freely convertible Euro currency regime within the EU single market. Capital account transactions are liberalized with prior notification thresholds for amounts exceeding EUR 100,000; profit remittances to shareholders are permitted post-tax settlement and beneficial ownership verification, subject to French tax residency rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: French exporters must declare export proceeds to customs authorities within 15 days of shipment via the Douane system. No mandatory surrender or central bank conversion is required; funds may be retained in foreign currency accounts. Full reporting to tax authorities is mandatory for VAT and corporate income tax compliance.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Cross-border electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise or Revolut are viable for treasury operations with feasibility rating High, subject to strict AML/KYC compliance and French tax reporting obligations under DAC6 and MIFID frameworks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is permitted for French SARL entities; physical presence of directors is not mandatory for standard onboarding, though video KYC interviews may be required for complex cross-border structures or high-value transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent beneficial ownership declarations or shell company indicators
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) certificates, corporate structure charts, and source of funds affidavits

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound-outbound fund cycling without economic rationale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trade contracts, export invoices, and bank statements demonstrating legitimate business purpose

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections from foreign investors are routed via SWIFT MT103 wires with purpose code 'CAPITAL' or 'INVESTMENT'. All transactions require prior KYC verification, source of wealth documentation, and alignment with French foreign exchange reporting thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements are facilitated through SWIFT MT103 for direct payments and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) for secured settlements. All must be supported by commercial invoices, packing lists, and export declarations filed with French customs.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency swaps and cross-currency basis swaps

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial court registry (greffe du tribunal de commerce), through the company’s registered-office registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Approve annual accounts within six months after financial year-end; deposit within one month after approval, or within two months if filed electronically.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: The president of the commercial court may order filing under penalty. Failure to deposit may result in a fine of up to EUR 1,500, increased to EUR 3,000 for repeat offences; there is no standard automatic strike-off period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 2065 and schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French tax administration (Direction générale des finances publiques, DGFiP)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within three months after financial year-end; for a calendar-year company, by the second working day after 1 May, subject to the applicable electronic filing calendar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing generally attracts a 10% surcharge, increased in specified cases, plus late-payment interest. Persistent non-compliance may prompt tax enforcement and company-dissolution proceedings; no automatic strike-off timetable applies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Pay the balance by the 15th day of the fourth month after financial year-end; for a calendar-year company, generally by 15 May. Instalments may also be due during the year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment generally incurs a 5% surcharge and late-payment interest, subject to statutory exceptions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor if it exceeds at least two of these thresholds at year-end: EUR 5 million total assets, EUR 10 million net turnover, or 50 employees. Other statutory triggers, including certain group or ownership circumstances, may also require appointment.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under the Plan comptable général (PCG) for statutory individual accounts; IFRS is required for consolidated accounts of listed groups and may apply where otherwise legally permitted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no general annual UBO confirmation filing. File an update with the commercial court registry within 30 days after any change to reportable beneficial ownership or its particulars. Record share transfers in the company’s required records and complete applicable tax and registry formalities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholder records and share-transfer documentation)
Register of Directors (manager appointment and cessation records)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Approximately USD 150–600 per year, depending on provider and services.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately USD 3,000–15,000 or more per year, depending on size, complexity, and transaction volume; no statutory audit fee applies if no auditor is required or appointed.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard French corporate income tax, Impôt sur les Sociétés 'IS', for fiscal years ending on or after 1 January 2022)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced IS rate of 15% on first EUR 42,500 of annual taxable profit for eligible SMEs (turnover <= EUR 10,000,000 and >=75% held by individuals); Crédit d'Impôt Recherche (CIR) of 30% of qualifying R&D expenditure up to EUR 100,000,000 per year (5% above); Crédit d'Impôt Innovation (CII) of 20% for innovation-prototype expenditure of SMEs, capped at EUR 400,000 per year; Jeune Entreprise Innovante (JEI) regime partially exempts IS for qualifying young innovative SMEs.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward (no statutory time limit); annual utilization capped at EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of any taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000. Optional one-year carryback of up to EUR 1,000,000.
